assert all(b["units"][0].get(k)==v for k,v in r["candidate_publication_context"]["lesson"].items())

for f in ["0.review-result.json","source-module-review.result.json"]:
 path=base/f; historical[str(path)]=path.read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(["git","show",old+":"+str(path)]); assert historical[str(path)]
hashes={f:hashlib.sha256(current[f]).hexdigest() for f in files}

assert pdfsha=="4e64124f7e36993ee784e575a024505f99d484ccf959d2d3864eae9232af8bf1"
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",".lake/packages/mathlib","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()=="db584cd6d46c92f209a44c0f1c829460d327499d"
